title: Virtual Care Weekly Frequency Limit and Open Requests of One Visit Type
content:
A patient may start no more than the visit type's weekly encounter limit of Virtual Care encounters of one visit type in any rolling 7 days, and holds no other encounter of the same visit type in status requested or in progress when a new one is requested.

## Clauses

**1. Weekly limit.** A patient may start no more than the visit type's weekly encounter limit of encounters of one type in any rolling 7 days.

**2. How the week is counted.** The count is the number of the patient's Virtual Care encounters of the same visit type whose request date falls inside the rolling 7 calendar days ending on the handling date and whose status is anything other than cancelled. A new request is allowed when that count is less than the visit type's weekly encounter limit; when the count equals or exceeds the limit, the request is not allowed.

**3. One open request per visit type.** The patient holds no other encounter of the same type in status requested or in progress. This is read from the system's record of the patient's encounters before the request is made, matching the same patient and the same visit type.

**4. Care beyond the limit.** A patient needing care beyond the weekly limit is offered an in-person visit instead.

## The window restated

The rolling 7 calendar days ending on the handling date are the handling date itself and the six calendar days before it. An encounter requested on the seventh calendar day before the handling date is outside the window.

## Which encounters each clause reads

| Encounter status | Counts toward the weekly limit (clause 2) | Blocks a new request of the same type (clause 3) |
|---|---|---|
| Requested | Yes | Yes |
| Scheduled | Yes | No |
| In progress | Yes | Yes |
| Completed | Yes | No |
| Converted to in-person | Yes | No |
| No-show | Yes | No |
| Cancelled | No | No |

Both clauses read encounters of the same visit type only; encounters of other visit types enter neither.

## The limit on both sides (hypothetical limit of 2)

| Same-type encounters counted in the window | Compared with a limit of 2 | New request under clause 2 |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | less than 2 | Allowed |
| 1 | less than 2 | Allowed |
| 2 | equal to 2 | Not allowed |
| 3 | more than 2 | Not allowed |

## Worked case (hypothetical dates and records)

Handling date 15 May, hypothetical weekly limit of 2 for the visit type. The window runs from 9 May to 15 May. The patient's encounters of the same visit type:

- requested 8 May, completed — outside the window, not counted;
- requested 10 May, cancelled — inside the window, not counted because it is cancelled;
- requested 12 May, completed — inside the window, counted.

The count is 1, which is less than 2, so clause 2 allows the request. Clause 3 is met because none of these encounters is in status requested or in progress.
